input.description: float tensor or list of tensors to quantize

scale.description: scale to apply in quantization formula

zero_point.description: offset in integer value that maps to float zero dtype (:class:`torch.dtype`): the desired data type of returned tensor. Has to be one of the quantized dtypes: ``torch.quint8``, ``torch.qint8``, ``torch.qint32``

output.description: A newly quantized tensor or list of quantized tensors.
